documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Dispatch Of Letter To Shareholders Of The Company Pursuant To Regulation 36(1)(B) Of The SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

analysis.summary: Ausom Enterprise Limited reported its operational and financial highlights for the financial year 2025-26 in its 42nd Annual Report, detailing a standalone revenue from operations of Rs. 79,910.58 Lakhs and a net profit after tax of Rs. 2,000.94 Lakhs. Management expressed an expectation to achieve a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs for the current year, for which resources have been generated.

guidance.claim: The management anticipates achieving a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs during the current year.
guidance.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

guidance.claim: The company anticipated achieving a gross turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs during the current year.
guidance.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

capex_expansion.claim: The company incorporated its wholly owned subsidiary Amazo Solar Power Private Limited and invested Rs. 100.00 Lakhs as equity share capital.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year the Company incorporated its Wholly own Subsidiary i.e. Amazo Solar Power Private Limited and invested Rs. 100.00 Lakhs as Equity Share Capital.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per equity share of Rs. 10 each for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 29th May, 2026, have recommended a Final Dividend of Rs. 1/- (Rupee One only) per equity share of Rs.10/- (Rupees Ten only) each, aggregating Rs. 1,36,23,552 for the F.Y. 2025-26, subject to the approval of Members at the ensuing 42nd Annual General Meeting of the Company and deduction of tax at source, as required under the law.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Re. 1/- per equity share of face value Rs. 10/- each for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare Final Dividend of Re. 1/- (10%) per equity share of face value of Rs. 10/- each, for the financial year 2024-2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The balance of total reserve and surplus amounted to Rs. 11,125.52 Lakhs as on March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: As a result as on 31st March, 2024 the balance of total reserve and surplus is amounting to Rs. 11,125.52 Lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: No significant and material orders were passed by regulators, courts, or tribunals impacting the going concern status during the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year no significant and material order were passed for or against the Company by any authorities which impact the going concern status and Companies future operations.

management_commitments.claim: The management targets achieving a gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs for the current year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross consolidated turnover of Rs. 2,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts have been initiated.

management_commitments.claim: The management stated that the target of gross turnover will definitely be achieved and necessary resources have been generated.
management_commitments.quote: The management of the Company is of the view that the target of gross turnover will definitely be achieved and necessary resources for the same have also been generated.

management_commitments.claim: The registered office of the company will be shifted to Bopal, Ahmedabad effective October 01, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: The Registered office of the Company will be shifted outside the local limits of the city, town or village i.e. from “11-B, New Ahmedabad Industrial Estate, Sarkhej Bavla Road, Village Moraiya, Ahmedabad – 382213, Gujarat, India to Zaveri House, Fourth Floor, Sanidhya, Opp Planet Landmark Hotel, Bopal- Ambli Road, Bopal, Ahmedabad – 380058, Gujarat, India” w.e.f. October 01, 2025, subject to approval of the members in Annual General Meeting of the Company.

management_commitments.quote: The Company during current year is anticipating to achieve gross turnover of Rs. 1,50,000 Lakhs and for that necessary efforts has been initiated.
